zh: 新增内置组件「运行成本」：一张卡报告整个宿主进程的常驻内存、堆、外部内存与 ArrayBuffer，以及看板卡片数、状态序列化总量、每张卡当前版本要加载的文档体积和组件库的类数与版本数，并把最近 60 次采样画成折线。单张卡片、渲染进程与 GPU 的内存拿不到，卡片上写明这一点。数据源 `widget-board:system.metrics` 只读宿主自己的内存与工作区，没有观众时不采样；卡片离开视口或页面隐藏时停止绘制与状态写入。
en: New built-in widget "Running cost": one card reports the whole host process's resident, heap, external and ArrayBuffer memory, the board's card count, serialized state size, the documents each card currently loads and the library's type and version counts, with the last 60 samples drawn as a sparkline. Per-card, renderer and GPU memory are not available and the card says so. The `widget-board:system.metrics` source reads only the host's own memory and workspace, samples nothing without an audience, and stops drawing and writing state when the card leaves the viewport or the page is hidden.
